reuse.why: Adds one assertion helper using the existing db.first access and calls it from every provider link function; no existing duplicate-link helper existed to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule lives in a single helper; only a one-call guard is repeated in each of the five pre-existing near-identical link functions, with the provider literal repeated.

placement.why: The guard sits next to the link functions in accounts/app.ts, before any side effect; link.ts (which holds findOrCreateBank) would also have been a reasonable home.

scope.why: Only the guard helper and its five calls are added; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Small, readable, single definition of 'already linked'; a future provider must remember to add the call because the link functions are still copied per provider.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount
